confidence_notes: Restaurant prices are reasonably well grounded in Shenzhen data; hostel averages cover small samples, and hotel anchors are holistic estimates. Cocktail pricing is moderated from a sparse downtown-club price using local beer as a reference; wine by the glass is inferred from bottle-wine and beer prices. The private-room average has an unclear occupancy basis, so the estimate uses the two-person interpretation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Shenzhen price references were available, so no proxy city was needed.
